opera_house.name: Sydney Opera House
opera_house.price_text: Free to walk around · guided tours roughly AUD 45–55 · check on the day
opera_house.tip: Walk the outside for free, then book a guided tour to see inside the halls.
opera_house.best: Morning for photos, evening for the harbour lights

harbour_bridge.name: Sydney Harbour Bridge
harbour_bridge.price_text: Free to walk across · BridgeClimb costs extra, check on the day
harbour_bridge.tip: Walk from The Rocks to Milsons Point for free harbour views. The climb is optional and pricey.

bondi.name: Bondi Beach
bondi.hours: Always open · lifeguards patrol in daylight hours
bondi.tip: Swim between the red and yellow flags. The coastal walk to Coogee starts at the south end.
bondi.best: Morning on weekdays; summer for swimming

the_rocks.name: The Rocks
the_rocks.hours: Streets always open · markets on weekends
the_rocks.tip: Come for the weekend market and the old laneways behind the main street.

darling_harbour.name: Darling Harbour
darling_harbour.price_text: Free to walk · attractions charge separately
darling_harbour.tip: Good for families in the evening. The walk to Barangaroo is short and scenic.

botanic_garden.name: Royal Botanic Garden Sydney
botanic_garden.tip: Walk to Mrs Macquarie's Point for the classic Opera House and bridge view.

taronga_zoo.name: Taronga Zoo Sydney
taronga_zoo.price_text: Adult tickets roughly AUD 45–55 · check on the day
taronga_zoo.tip: Take the ferry from Circular Quay. It is part of the day out.

fox_studios.name: Fox Studios Australia
fox_studios.landmark: Fox Studios Australia (was part of Royal Agricultural Society Showground)
fox_studios.price_text: Working studio · not generally open to the public
fox_studios.hours: Not a public attraction, check on the day
fox_studios.tip: This is a film studio, not a visitor site. Skip it unless you have business there.

kaos_arcade.name: KAOS-Indoor Amusement arcade
kaos_arcade.price_text: Pay per game · check on the day
kaos_arcade.tip: Small arcade for a rainy hour. Confirm it is open before you go.

luna_park.name: Luna Park Sydney
luna_park.price_text: Free entry · rides cost extra, check on the day
luna_park.tip: Entry is free. The big smiling face gate is the photo. Buy ride passes only if you plan to ride.

manly_beach.name: Manly Beach
manly_beach.hours: Always open · lifeguards in daylight hours
manly_beach.tip: Take the ferry from Circular Quay. The crossing is half the fun.
manly_beach.best: Morning ferry, beach in the afternoon

manly_waterworks.name: Manly Waterworks
manly_waterworks.tip: Small waterslide park. Check it is open and running before you plan around it.

meat_pie.name: Meat pie
meat_pie.price_text: Roughly AUD 6–12 at a bakery or pie shop
meat_pie.tip: A classic Aussie snack. Try one from a local bakery, not a tourist stand.

qvb.name: Queen Victoria Building
qvb.tip: Step inside for the stained glass and the hanging clock. Good rainy-day stop.

easter_show.name: Royal Easter Show
easter_show.price_text: Ticket prices vary by year · check on the day
easter_show.hours: Runs for about two weeks around Easter
easter_show.tip: Only on around Easter. Book tickets ahead if you are in town then.

sea_life.name: SEA LIFE Sydney Aquarium
sea_life.price_text: Adult tickets roughly AUD 40–50 · book online for less
sea_life.tip: Book online to skip the queue and pay less. Good for a rainy day.

st_marys.name: St Mary's Cathedral
st_marys.hours: Usually open daily, check on the day
st_marys.tip: Quiet, cool and free. Dress respectfully and check mass times.

fish_market.name: Sydney Fish Market
fish_market.price_text: Pay per item · lunch roughly AUD 15–30
fish_market.hours: Usually from early morning to late afternoon
fish_market.tip: Go before lunch for the best choice. Eat outside and watch the seagulls.

mardi_gras.name: Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras
mardi_gras.landmark: Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras
mardi_gras.price_text: Parade viewing often free · party tickets cost extra
mardi_gras.hours: Usually February–March, check on the day
mardi_gras.tip: Only around February–March. The parade is the free highlight.

harbour.name: Sydney Harbour
harbour.tip: The best free view is from the Botanic Garden or the ferry deck.

ferry.name: Sydney Harbour Ferry
ferry.price_text: Single fares roughly AUD 6–8 with an Opal card · check on the day
ferry.hours: Runs from early morning to late evening
ferry.tip: Take the Manly or Watsons Bay ferry for a cheap harbour cruise. Tap on with an Opal card.

tower_eye.name: Sydney Tower Eye
tower_eye.price_text: Adult tickets roughly AUD 30–40 · book online
tower_eye.tip: Go near sunset for day and night views in one visit.

bondi_coogee_walk.name: Bondi to Coogee coastal walk
bondi_coogee_walk.tip: About 6 km one way. Take water, a hat and swim gear for the small beaches on the way.

barangaroo.name: Barangaroo Reserve and Wulugul Walk
barangaroo.tip: Quiet waterfront walk from Darling Harbour to the Rocks. Good sunset spot.

newtown_walk.name: Newtown King Street walk
newtown_walk.price_text: Free to walk · food and drinks extra
newtown_walk.hours: Shops and cafes vary, busiest in the evening
newtown_walk.tip: A lively neighbourhood for cheap eats and street art. Take the train to Newtown station.

blue_mountains.name: Blue Mountains day tour
blue_mountains.price_text: Guided day tours roughly AUD 100–180 · check on the day
blue_mountains.tip: A full day out of the city. Bring a jacket, it is cooler in the mountains.

paddington_markets.name: Paddington Markets
paddington_markets.price_text: Free entry · buy what you like
paddington_markets.hours: Usually Saturdays only, check on the day
paddington_markets.tip: Local crafts and food on Saturdays. Pair it with a walk down Oxford Street.
